title: Review every Tarium publication surface for private-content exposure
abstract: Before publicly publishing Tarium project material, review source files, fixtures, metadata, documentation, images, generated output, changes, commit text and release artifacts for private-origin disclosures; do not treat an automated signature check as proof of safety.

scope_hints.scope_boundary: Only explicitly authorized work on independent public Tarium projects

remarks: Public-source rule normalization reviewed as a distinct project-specific atom; overlapping general rules retained.
